Rise of the Planet of the Apes

programme.desc: The Messiah (HWV 56) by Georg Frederich Handel, tells the life and suffering of Christ: a story of passion, fire, and sacrifice. This performance of the Dutch ensemble Ribattuta Musica under the direction of conductor Dick Duijst was filmed in the grand church of the city of Ermelo, the Netherlands, in 2016.
programme.title: Handel - Messiah, HWV 56

programme.desc: Italian conductor Mattia Rondelli conducts the Orchestra dell’Opera Carlo Felice Genova in a concert program consisting of works by Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart and Giuseppe Sarti. Soprano Barbara Massaro is the soloist. On the program are Mozart’s Symphony No. 5 in B-flat major, K. 22; ‘Domine Deus’ from Sarti’s Gloria in excelsis (revised by Stefano Squarzina); ‘Sinfonia’, and the aria ‘Sull’altare del Suo sdegno’ from Sarti’s oratorio La sconfitta de’ Cananei (rev. S. Squarzina); Mozart’s Symphony No. 27 in G major, K. 199; the aria ‘Fra le oscure ombre funeste’ from Mozart’s cantata Davide Penitente, K. 469; and Mozart’s Symphony No. 24 in B-flat major, K. 182. This performance was recorded at the basilica of Santi Gervasio e Protasio in Rapallo, Italy, in 2023.
programme.title: Works by Mozart and Sarti

programme.desc: Renowned French string quartet Quatuor Ébène marked the 250th birth anniversary of Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827) with a remarkable project: recording all of the great composer’s sixteen string quartets. For five years, violinists Pierre Colombet and Gabriel Le Magadure, violist Marie Chilemme, and cellist Raphaël Merlin immersed themselves in Beethoven’s 650 pages of sheet music. This program features Quatuor Ébène performing Beethoven’s String Quartet No. 2 in G major, Op. 18, No. 2; String Quartet No. 16 in F major, Op. 135; and String Quartet No. 14 in C-sharp minor, Op. 131. This concert was recorded at Philharmonie de Paris on December 16, 2020.
programme.title: Beethoven-String Quartet No. 16, Op. 135

programme.desc: Under the direction of Conrad van Alphen, the Sinfonia Rotterdam Orchestra performs Haydn's Symphony No. 45. In this piece nicknamed "Farewell", the musicians finish the last movement by blowing out their candles and leaving the stage.
programme.title: Haydn - Symphony No. 45 'Farewell'

programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birth anniversary, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. In this performance, Schwartz presents Schumann’s Symphonic Etudes, Op. 13. Composed between 1834-37, the work began as a theme and a set of sixteen variations. The theme had been composed by Baron von Fricken, an amateur musician and father of Ernestine von Fricken, to whom Schumann was engaged in 1834.
programme.title: Schumann - Symphonic Etudes, Op. 13

programme.desc: The Imperial Ice Stars ice dance production of Cinderella is set in Siberia. The beloved story has been given a new and original twist by award winning artistic director Tony Mercer. Performed to a specially commissioned original musical score with a cast of 26 skaters, the show was shot live in August 2008 in Melbourne, Australia. Original score composed by Tim Duncan and Edward Barnwell.
programme.title: Ice Dance: Cinderella 2008

programme.desc: The Maggio Musicale Fiorentino (Florence Musical May) is Italy’s oldest opera and arts festival. As part of the festival’s 2021 edition, Sir John Eliot Gardiner leads the Orchestra del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in a wonderful concert program that includes Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky’s Symphony No. 2 in C minor, Op. 17, ‘Little Russian’, and Edward Elgar’s Variations on an Original Theme, Op. 36, better known as the Enigma Variations. This performance was recorded at Teatro del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in Florence, Italy, in 2021.
programme.title: Tchaikovsky - Symphony No. 2, Op. 17

programme.desc: J. S. Bach’s six Brandenburg Concerto’s belong to his best-known works. In celebration of the pieces’ 300th anniversary, Czech harpsichordist and conductor Václav Luks and the renowned Baroque ensemble Collegium 1704 present Bach’s Brandenburg Concerto No. 3 in G major, BWV 1048.
programme.title: Bach - Brandenburg Concerto No. 3

programme.desc: Italian pianist Andrea Molteni (1998) performs Frédéric Chopin’s Fantaisie in F minor, Op. 49. Molteni began studying the piano at the age of six. He graduated with honors and honorable mention at the Conservatorio di musica Giuseppe Verdi di Como, and was awarded a master’s degree Magna cum Laude in Advanced Performance Studies by the Conservatorio della Svizzera Italiana in Lugano. This performance was recorded at the Oberlin Conservatory of Music, Ohio, USA, in 2022.
programme.title: Chopin - Fantaisie in F minor, Op. 49

programme.desc: Conductor Eduard Topchjan leads the Armenian National Philharmonic Orchestra in a performance of Ludwig van Beethoven’s Piano Concerto No. 3 in C minor, Op. 37. Russian-born pianist Maya Oganyan (*2005) makes her solo debut with the orchestra. As an encore, Oganyan performs Der Bote (‘The Messenger’) by Ukrainian composer Valentin Silvestrov. This performance was recorded at the Aram Khachaturian Concert Hall in Yerevan, Armenia, in 2021.
programme.title: Beethoven - Piano Concerto No. 3 in C minor

programme.desc: Marta Gardolińska conducts the London Symphony Orchestra in a concert program consisting of Lili Boulanger’s D’un Martin de Printemps, Marc-André Dalbavie’s Concerto for Flute (soloist is Gareth Davies), and Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky’s Symphony No. 4 in F minor, Op. 36. This concert was recorded at LSO St Luke’s in London, UK, on May 18, 2022.
programme.title: The LSO performs Boulanger, Dalbavie & Tchaikovsky

programme.desc: The documentary “The Three Lives of Clara Schumann” traces the fascinating life story of German pianist and composer Clara Schumann. Basing itself on her letters and diaries, her compositions, and on accounts from musicians who have intensively studied her music, this 2019 documentary offers a multi-angled perspective on Clara Schumann.
programme.title: The Three Lives of Clara Schumann

programme.desc: The opera ‘Mariken in the Garden of Earthly Delights,’ to music by Calliope Tsoupaki, is based on the play ‘Mariken van Nieumeghen.’ The ASKO-Schönberg and the Tetraktys Ensemble are led by Hernán Schvartzman. Recorded at the Royal Theater in The Hague, in 2015.
programme.title: Mariken in the Garden of Earthly Delights

programme.desc: Italian pianist Andrea Molteni (1998) performs Alban Berg’s Piano Sonata in B minor, Op. 1. Molteni began studying the piano at the age of six. He graduated with honors and honorable mention at the Conservatorio di musica Giuseppe Verdi di Como, and was awarded a master’s degree Magna cum Laude in Advanced Performance Studies by the Conservatorio della Svizzera Italiana in Lugano. This performance was recorded at the Verbrugghen Hall of the Sydney Conservatorium of Music, Australia, in 2023.
programme.title: Berg - Piano Sonata, Op. 1

programme.desc: Pianist Gabriele Strata (Italy, 1999) joins the CMIM ensemble, consisting of three principal strings players of the Montreal Symphony Orchestra, in a performance of the first movement, Sostenuto assai – Allegro ma non troppo, of Robert Schumann’s Piano Quartet in E-flat major, Op. 47. This performance took place during the chamber music round of the two-part semi-final of the Piano Edition of the Concours musical international de Montréal 2024 (CMIM). It was recorded at the Bourgie Hall of the Montreal Museum of Fine Arts.
programme.title: CMIM Piano 2024 - Semi-final I: Gabriele Strata

programme.desc: Violinists Francesca Dego and Domenico Nordio and pianist Andrea Bacchetti perform Serenade in A major, Op. 92 by Norwegian composer Christian Sinding (1856-1941). Together with Edvard Grieg, Sinding was Norway’s best-known composer at the turn of the century. Composing in the late Romantic style, Sinding’s oeuvre includes a large number of piano pieces, chamber music, and songs. This performance was recorded at Teatro Comunale Città di Vicenza, Italy, on December 2, 2013.
programme.title: Sinding - Serenade in A major, Op. 92

programme.desc: French violinist Renaud Capuçon appears at the festival Les Coups de Cœur de Chantilly, presenting a chamber music program consisting of classical and 20th century repertoire. He performs with the soloists of the International Menuhin Music Academy led by French conductor Jean-Jacques Kantorow. On the program are Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s Sinfonia Concertante in E-flat major, K. 364, Mozart’s Sonata for violin and piano in E minor, K. 304, and Dmitri Shostakovich’s Chamber Symphony in C minor, Op. 110a.
programme.title: Chamber music by Mozart and Shostakovich

programme.desc: The DR Symphony Orchestra breaks the sound barrier and takes you out into the galaxies — to a place between reality and fantasy with soundtracks from Star Wars, The Mandalorian, Star Trek, Dune, and many more.
programme.title: Galaxmphony - The Final Odyssey

programme.desc: The documentary “Clara Haskil - Le mystère de l’interprète” (2017) tells the remarkable life story of Romanian pianist Clara Haskil (1895-1960). Born in Bucharest into a Jewish family, she began her career as a child prodigy, entering the Bucharest Conservatory at a very young age. Haskil suffered from chronic health issues and lived through two world wars, which held back her career. Only after WWII, Haskil’s fame began to take off and she finally enjoyed international recognition.
programme.title: Clara Haskil - Le mystère de l’interprète

programme.desc: Michael Tilson Thomas conducts the London Symphony Orchestra in a pleasing performance of Tchaikovsky's folk-infused Symphony No. 2 - the 'Little Russian'. This performance is recorded at St. Luke's London on May 31st, 2021.
programme.title: Tchaikovsky - Symphony No. 2, Op. 17

programme.desc: For three years, Daniel Barenboim and the West-Eastern Divan Orchestra presented the nine Beethoven symphonies on a world tour. Director Michael Waldman drew a captivating documentary.
programme.title: Nine Symphonies That Changed the World

programme.desc: Celebrated German violinist Isabelle Faust performs two of J. S. Bach’s incredible works for solo violin: Partita No. 2 in D minor (BWV 1004), and Sonata No. 3 in C major (BWV 1005). In this wonderful performance, Faust shows her mastery of Bach’s technically challenging pieces. This performance was recorded at St. Thomas Church in Leipzig, Germany, in 2020.
programme.title: Bach - Partita for Violin No. 2 (BWV 1004)

programme.desc: A colourful Christmas concert by the South Netherlands Philharmonic with Tchaikovsky’s famous First Piano Concerto. Chief conductor Dmitry Liss showcases, together with master pianist Boris Berezovsky, a true, Russian spirit.
programme.title: Tchaikovsky - Piano Concerto No. 1

programme.desc: Conductor Jan Latham-Koenig leads the Flanders Symphony Orchestra in this concert recorded at Concertgebouw Brugge, Belgium, on April 21, 2016. The program includes Felix Mendelssohn’s concert overture Die Hebriden, Op. 26 (The Hebrides); Edvard Grieg’s Piano Concerto in A minor, Op. 16, featuring Pascal Amoyel as the pianist; and Ludwig van Beethoven’s Symphony No. 7 in A major, Op. 92.
programme.title: Grieg - Piano Concerto in A minor, Op. 16

programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle leads the London Symphony Orchestra in Gustav Mahler’s poignant song cycle ‘Das Lied von der Erde’ (The Song of the Earth). Joining him are two of today's leading vocalists: mezzo-soprano Magdalena Kožená and tenor Andrew Staples. Written in the final years of his life, Mahler’s masterpiece contemplates the beauty of life and the sorrow of parting through some of his most personal and beautiful symphonic writing.
programme.title: Mahler - Das Lied von der Erde

programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle leads the London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) and Chorus in a performance of Ludwig van Beethoven’s Symphony No. 9 in D minor, Op. 125. The soloists are Iwona Sobotka (soprano), Anna Stephany (mezzo-soprano), Robert Murray (tenor), and Florian Boesch (baritone). This performance was recorded at Barbican Hall in London, on February 16, 2020.
programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 9, Op. 125

programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birth anniversary, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. In this performance, Schwartz presents Schumann’s Piano Sonata No. 2 in G minor, Op. 22. The composer completed the work in 1838. Of Schumann’s three piano sonatas, Piano Sonata No. 2 is performed and recorded most frequently.
programme.title: Schumann - Piano Sonata No. 2 in G minor, Op. 22

programme.desc: Johan de Meij conducts Symphony No. 1 for woodwind and brass orchestra. The work is titled “Lord of the Rings” and is based on the trilogy by J. R. R. Tolkien. This concert is recorded at the Sala dei Teatini of the Teatri di Piacenza in 2018.
programme.title: Johan de Meij - Symphony No. 1 “Lord of the Rings”

programme.desc: The film Jaroussky sings Bach & Telemann is a portrait of a very special vocalist - and of two exceptional composers: Telemann and Bach.
programme.title: Jaroussky sings Bach & Telemann

programme.desc: J. S. Bach’s six Brandenburg Concerto’s belong to his best-known works. In celebration of the pieces’ 300th anniversary, Czech harpsichordist and conductor Václav Luks and the renowned Baroque ensemble Collegium 1704 present Bach’s Brandenburg Concerto No. 2 in F major, BWV 1047.
programme.title: Bach - Brandenburg Concerto No. 2

programme.desc: Dutch choreographer Hans van Manen (1932) is internationally recognized as one of the grand masters of contemporary ballet. In the documentary ‘Hans van Manen – Moving to Music’ (2022), Van Manen reflects on his life, work, and the inspirations behind ballets charged with drama and eroticism. The film features excerpts from some of his most successful ballets.
programme.title: Hans van Manen – Moving to Music

programme.desc: Conrad van Alphen leads Sinfonia Rotterdam in a performance of Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky’s Symphony No. 1 in G minor, Op. 13, ‘Winter Daydreams’, recorded at De Doelen in Rotterdam, the Netherlands in September 2022.
programme.title: Tchaikovsky - Symphony No. 1 in G minor, Op. 13

programme.desc: Russian pianist Nikolay Lugansky has received world-wide praise for his interpretations of the music of Sergei Rachmaninoff. In this wonderful recital, the great pianist presents works by the Russian Romantic composer as well as Ludwig van Beethoven and Alexander Glazunov. This performance was recorded at the Tchaikovsky Concert Hall in Moscow, Russia, on June 4, 2021.
programme.title: Glazunov – Sonata No. 2 - II. Scherzo

programme.desc: On Saturday, August 27, 2016, OVG and Sinfonia Rotterdam presented a new Veerhavenconcert under the direction of Conrad van Alphen. This fantastic concert includes works by Mendelssohn, Mozart, Haydn, Rossini, Beethoven, and Fauré.
programme.title: Veerhavenconcert 2016

programme.desc: American conductor Jonathon Heyward makes his debut with the London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) with this performance of Antonín Dvořák’s beloved Symphony No. 9 in E minor, Op. 95, "From the New World". This performance was recorded at LSO St. Luke’s on Old Street in London, UK, on September 30, 2020.
programme.title: Heyward conducts Dvořák’s Symphony No. 9

programme.desc: In this episode of ‘In Rehearsal,’ Latvian maestro Mariss Jansons guides the Oslo Philharmonic through the powerful Suite from Béla Bartók’s pantomime ballet The Miraculous Mandarin, culminating in a performance at the Oslo Concert Hall.
programme.title: In Rehearsal: Mariss Jansons

programme.desc: Bulgarian conductor Pavel Baleff conducts the Orchestra and Choir of the Opéra de Limoges in a performance of Antonín Dvořák’s lyric fairytale opera Rusalka (1900). Stage director Nicola Raab and TV director Arnaud Lalanne created a truly filmic production of Dvořák’s masterpiece. Among the soloists are Ruzan Mantashyan, Adam Smith, Rafal Pawnuk, Marie-Adeline Henry, Marion Lebègue, and Alexandra Marcellier. This performance was recorded at the Opéra de Limoges, France, in February 2021.
programme.title: Dvořák - Rusalka

programme.desc: In 2021, Kader Belarbi, choreographer and director of dance of the Théâtre du Capitole de Toulouse, brought his 1998 ballet ‘Les Saltimbanques’ back to the stage. Inspired by Pablo Picasso’s painting ‘Famille de saltimbanques’ (Family of Saltimbanques, 1905) and the fifth of German poet Rainer Maria Rilke’s ‘Duino Elegies’ (1922), Belarbi animates the company of acrobats from Picasso’s canvas, bringing circus and dance together. This performance was recorded at the Halle aux Grains in Toulouse, France, in 2021.
programme.title: Les Saltimbanques

programme.desc: The Rina Sala Gallo International Piano Competition takes place every two years in the Italian city of Monza. This broadcast featuring the three finalists’ best performances from the competition’s 26th edition, were recorded at the Villa Reale di Monza in October 2022. The finalists are Young Sun Choi (South Korea, 1991), Seunghyuk Na (South Korea, 1997), and Ivan Bašić (Serbia, 1996).
programme.title: Rina Sala Gallo Piano Competition 2022 - Finalists

programme.desc: Luca Vignali (oboe), Angelo De Angelis (clarinet), Carmine Pinto (horn), Eliseo Smordoni (bassoon), and Linda Di Carlo (piano) perform Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s Quintet for piano and winds in E-flat major, K. 452. This performance was recorded at Perugia’s Auditorium Santa Cecilia, Italy, on June 23, 2022.
programme.title: Mozart - Quintet for piano and winds, K. 452

programme.desc: Iván Fischer leads his Budapest Festival Orchestra (BFO) in a concert program dedicated to the music of Ludwig van Beethoven. The program opens with the composer’s Symphony No. 1 in C major, Op. 21. Afterward, Fischer conducts Beethoven’s Piano Concerto No. 4 in G major, Op. 58, in which Richard Goode features as the soloist. The program closes with Beethoven’s famous Symphony No. 5 in C minor, Op. 67. This performance was recorded at the Béla Bartók National Concert Hall in Budapest, Hungary, on January 29, 2017.
programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 1 - IV. Adagio

programme.desc: Renowned French string quartet Quatuor Ébène marked the 250th birth anniversary of Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827) with a remarkable project: recording all of the great composer’s sixteen string quartets. For five years, violinists Pierre Colombet and Gabriel Le Magadure, violist Marie Chilemme, and cellist Raphaël Merlin immersed themselves in Beethoven’s 650 pages of sheet music. This program features Quatuor Ébène performing Beethoven’s String Quartet No. 2 in G major, Op. 18, No. 2; String Quartet No. 16 in F major, Op. 135; and String Quartet No. 14 in C-sharp minor, Op. 131. This concert was recorded at Philharmonie de Paris on December 16, 2020.
programme.title: Beethoven - String Quartet No. 2, Op. 18, No. 2

programme.desc: Chinese pianist Zhu Xiao-Mei performs J. S. Bach's Goldberg Variations (BWV 988) at the Leipzig Bach Festival 2014. This June 2014 concert was recorded at St. Thomas Church. The Goldberg Variations consists of one aria and a set of 30 variations. The work was first published in 1741 and was named after harpsichordist Johann Gottlieb Goldberg.
programme.title: Bach - Goldberg Variations (BWV 988)

programme.desc: In this concert at the Lucerne Festival, Argentine pianist Martha Argerich performs Ludwig van Beethoven’s Piano Concerto No. 1 in C major, Op. 15 with the Lucerne Festival Orchestra under the baton of Swedish conductor Herbert Blomstedt. Beethoven's Symphony No. 2 in D major, Op. 36, is also on the program. This performance was recorded at the Lucerne Culture and Congress Center (KKL), Switzerland, in August 2020.
programme.title: Beethoven - Piano Concerto No. 1 & Symphony No. 2

programme.desc: This documentary by Christoph Keller follows various participants and teachers participating in the International Summer Piano Academy.
programme.title: The Pianists Keys

programme.desc: On the occasion of her 80th birthday, Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich explored chamber music repertoire in this wonderful concert, recorded at Château de Chantilly, France. The ‘Grande Dame’ of the piano is joined by various renowned artists, including pianists Lily Maisky and Iddo Bar-Shaï, violinists Tedi Papavrami and Akiko Suwanai, her daughter Lyda Chen-Argerich on viola, and cellist Mischa Maisky. On the program are Felix Mendelssohn’s Piano Trio No. 1 in D minor, Op. 49; Leoš Janáček’s Violin Sonata; Franz Schubert’s Rondo in A major, D. 951; and Johannes Brahms’s Piano Quartet No. 3 in C minor, Op. 60. These performances were recorded on May 4 and June 13, 2021.
programme.title: Schubert - Rondo D. 951

programme.desc: The Messiah (HWV 56) by Georg Frederich Handel, tells the life and suffering of Christ: a story of passion, fire, and sacrifice. This performance of the Dutch ensemble Ribattuta Musica under the direction of conductor Dick Duijst was filmed in the grand church of the city of Ermelo, the Netherlands, in 2016.
programme.title: Handel - Messiah, HWV 56

programme.desc: In this splendid concert, exceptional Russian pianists Nikolay Lugansky and Vadim Rudenko join forces in a program for two pianos comprising works of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart, Maurice Ravel, Anton Arensky, Sergei Rachmaninoff, and Nikolai Kapustin. Both pianists, laureates of the prestigious International Tchaikovsky Competition in 1994, have received international recognition. This performance was recorded at the Tchaikovsky Concert Hall in Moscow, Russia, on November 25, 2021.
programme.title: Piano Duets - Mozart, Ravel, Rachmaninoff a. o.

programme.desc: Soprano Sophia Burgos (USA, 1991) and pianist Daniel Gerzenberg (Germany, 1991) perform works by Hugo Wolf, Manuel de Falla, Maurice Ravel, Igor Stravinsky, Gerrit Isaac van Eijken, Joseph Marx, Robert Schumann, Francis Poulenc, and George Crumb, during the final round of the International Vocal Competition 2021 – Lied Duo. This performance was recorded at De Verkadefabriek in ’s-Hertogenbosch, the Netherlands.
programme.title: IVC 2021 - Final: Wolf, De Falla, Poulenc a. o.

programme.desc: Iván Fischer leads his Budapest Festival Orchestra (BFO) in a concert program dedicated to the music of Ludwig van Beethoven. The program opens with the composer’s Symphony No. 1 in C major, Op. 21. Afterward, Fischer conducts Beethoven’s Piano Concerto No. 4 in G major, Op. 58, in which Richard Goode features as the soloist. The program closes with Beethoven’s famous Symphony No. 5 in C minor, Op. 67. This performance was recorded at the Béla Bartók National Concert Hall in Budapest, Hungary, on January 29, 2017.
programme.title: Beethoven - Symphonies and Piano Concerto No. 4

programme.desc: Conrad van Alphen conducts Sinfonia Rotterdam in a performance of Saint-Saëns’ Symphony No. 3, Op. 78, recorded on October 20th, 2018 in Rotterdam. It is known as the Organ Symphony since the instrument is used in the second and fourth movement of the work.
programme.title: Saint-Saëns - Symphony No. 3, Op. 78

programme.desc: Sergei Prokofiev based his ballet ‘Romeo and Juliet’ on William Shakespeare's famous play of the same name, telling the story of two young lovers from the feuding families Montague and Capulet. Acclaimed French choreographer Jean-Christophe Maillot created a distinctive choreography of the ballet in 1996, which has been performed to great success the world over. This 2002 interpretation is performed by the dancers of Les Ballets de Monte Carlo.
programme.title: Romeo and Juliet

programme.desc: Italian cellist Silvia Chiesa and Italian pianist Maurizio Baglini perform a wonderful recital of works by Ferruccio Busoni, Franz Liszt, Frédéric Chopin, and Sergei Rachmaninoff.
programme.title: Rachmaninoff - Sonata for Cello, Op. 19

programme.desc: Iván Fischer leads his Budapest Festival Orchestra in an exciting concert program consisting of works by J. S. Bach, Béla Bartók, and Johannes Brahms. The program opens with Bach’s Brandenburg Concerto No. 3 in G major, BWV 1048. This is followed by one of Bartók’s best-known pieces: Music for strings, percussion and celesta. The program ends with Brahms’s Symphony No. 3 in F major, Op. 90. This performance was recorded at the Béla Bartók National Concert Hall in Budapest, Hungary, on December 4, 2017.
programme.title: Works by Bach, Bartók, and Brahms

programme.desc: This episode of the series 'In the Artist's Workshop' features a masterclass by French classical pianist Philippe Cassard in the works of Claude Debussy.
programme.title: In the Artist's Workshop

programme.desc: In a 2019 performance from the Muziekgebouw in Eindhoven, Hartmut Haenchen conducts the philharmonie zuidnederland for this performance of Anton Bruckner’s Symphony No. 7. The majestic opening theme of the first movement of Anton Bruckner’s Symphony No. 7 foreshadows a momentous work, lasting over 20 minutes. The doubt and turmoil felt throughout the Adagio, the second movement, are supposedly Bruckner's response to the news of the death of his idol, Richard Wagner.
programme.title: Bruckner - Symphony No. 7

programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birth anniversary, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. In this performance, Schwartz presents Schumann’s Novelletten, Op. 21. The eight pieces for piano that make up this song cycle are often performed separately. It bears a dedication to pianist Adolph Henselt. Schumann composed the pieces between January and April of 1838, around the same time as Kinderszenen, Op. 18, and Kreisleriana, Op. 16.
programme.title: Schumann - Novelletten, Op. 21

programme.desc: Daniel Harding leads the Orchestra and Choir of the Maggio Musicale Fiorentino and four vocal soloists in a magnificent performance of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s Requiem in D minor, K. 626. The soloists are soprano Christiane Karg, mezzosoprano Sara Mingardo, tenor Matthew Swensen, and bass Gianluca Buratto. This performance was recorded at Teatro del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in Florence, Italy, in 2021.
programme.title: Mozart - Requiem in D minor, K. 626

programme.desc: This unique production of Carl Maria von Weber’s 'Der Freischütz' was created to celebrate both the piece’s 200th premiere anniversary at Konzerthaus Berlin and the 200th anniversary of the famed concert hall itself. Christoph Eschenbach conducts Konzerthausorchester Berlin and Rundfunkchor Berlin in this 2021 performance.
programme.title: Von Weber - Der Freischütz

programme.desc: Set to the original score of Tchaikovsky's masterpiece, the Imperial Ice Stars present their 2015 interpretation of Swan Lake, complete with an exhilarating choreography from leading ice director Tony Mercer, enchanting settings and dazzling costumes.
programme.title: Ice Dance: Swan Lake (2015)

programme.desc: This chamber music concert is part of ‘Preludio’ concert series of the Reina Sofía School of Music in Madrid. This performance was recorded at Auditorio Sony of the Reina Sofía School of Music in Madrid, Spain, on April 30, 2024.
programme.title: Chamber music by Haydn, Tchaikovsky and others

programme.desc: Renowned French string quartet Quatuor Ébène marked the 250th birth anniversary of Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827) with a remarkable project: recording all of the great composer’s sixteen string quartets. For five years, violinists Pierre Colombet and Gabriel Le Magadure, violist Marie Chilemme, and cellist Raphaël Merlin immersed themselves in Beethoven’s 650 pages of sheet music. This program features Quatuor Ébène performing Beethoven’s String Quartet No. 5 in A major, Op. 18, No. 5; String Quartet No. 4 in C minor, Op. 18, No. 4; and String Quartet No. 12 in E-flat major, Op. 127. This concert was recorded at Philharmonie de Paris on December 17, 2020.
programme.title: Beethoven - String Quartet No. 12, Op. 127

programme.desc: The Berliner Philharmoniker is one of the world’s finest orchestras, its fame stretching all the way to Japan. Unsurprisingly, this 2000 concert, recorded at Tokyo’s magnificent Suntory Hall, was a resounding success.
programme.title: Von Weber - Overture to Oberon

programme.desc: Pianist Anthony Ratinov (USA, 1997) joins the CMIM ensemble, consisting of three principal strings players of the Montreal Symphony Orchestra, in a performance of the first movement, Sostenuto assai – Allegro ma non troppo, of Robert Schumann’s Piano Quartet in E-flat major, Op. 47. This performance took place during the chamber music round of the two-part semi-final of the Piano Edition of the Concours musical international de Montréal 2024 (CMIM). It was recorded at the Bourgie Hall of the Montreal Museum of Fine Arts.
programme.title: CMIM Piano 2024 - Semi-final I: Anthony Ratinov

programme.desc: Belgian conductor Jos van Immerseel leads Anima Eterna Brugge in a concert program dedicated to American composer George Gershwin. Soprano Claron McFadden features as the soloist, presenting a selection of Gershwin’s classic jazz songs. Pianist Bart Van Caenegem is the soloist in Gershwin’s celebrated Rhapsody in Blue. This performance was recorded at Concertgebouw Brugge, Belgium, on March 3, 2017.
programme.title: Gershwin - Greatest Hits

programme.desc: Rodolfo Barráez conducts the Orchestra and Choir of the Academia de Musica del Palacia de Mineria in a performance of Carl Orff's Carmina Burana. Soloists are Anabel de la Mora (soprano), Andrés Carrillo (tenor) and Cerón (bariton).
programme.title: Orff - Carmina Burana

programme.desc: One of the world’s most popular pieces of classical music, Maurice Ravel’s Boléro (1928), was no longer copyrighted as of May 1, 2016. Up to then it had made Ravel and his heirs millions. Ravel died in 1937 and left all he owned to his brother Edouard. Edouard’s death in 1960 unleashed a complex legal battle over the rights, involving among others Edouard’s nurse and her husband. This 2017 documentary gives a fascinating account of what happened to one this iconic piece of music right under the nose of the public. Filmmaker Fabien Caux-Lahalle underpins this investigative story with clips of the Boléro in various guises.
programme.title: Who has stolen the Boléro by Maurice Ravel?

programme.desc: Olivier Latry, the current holder of the Great Organ of Notre Dame, plays Pierre Cochereau’s Boléro, Louis Vierne’s Carillon of Westminster and Scherzo from Symphony No. 2, Alexandre Guilmant’s Sonata No. 1, and more.
programme.title: In the Organ's Stomach

programme.desc: The soloists of the Lucerne Festival Orchestra present two septets in this engaging 2020 concert, recorded at Lucerne Culture and Congress Center (KKL), Switzerland. The concert opens with Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s Divertimento No. 11 in D major, K. 251, known as the ‘Nannerl-Septet’. This is followed by Ludwig van Beethoven’s Septet in E-flat major, Op. 20.
programme.title: Septets by Mozart and Beethoven

programme.desc: Italian conductor Gianandrea Noseda leads the London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) in a performance of Ludwig van Beethoven’s Piano Concerto No. 5 in E-flat major, Op. 73, famously known as the ‘Emperor’ Concerto. Italian pianist Beatrice Rana features as the soloist here. The New York Times describes her as ‘one of the most insightful and prodigiously gifted artists of the new generation’. This concert was recorded at London’s Barbican Hall, UK, on February 2, 2022.
programme.title: Beethoven - Piano Concerto No. 5, 'Emperor'

programme.desc: On the occasion of her 80th birthday, Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich explored repertoire for piano and violin in this wonderful concert, recorded at Château de Chantilly, France. The ‘Grande Dame’ of the piano is joined by various renowned artists, including pianists Evgeny Kissin, Theodosia Ntokou, and Cristina Marton-Argerich, and violinist Maxim Vengerov. On the program are Dmitri Shostakovich’s Concertino for two pianos, Op. 94; Frédéric Chopin’s Impromptu No. 3, Op. 51, Polonaise No. 6, Op. 53 “Heroic”, and Waltz No. 6, Op. 64 No. 1; Camille Saint-Saëns’s Polonaise for two pianos, Op. 77; César Franck’s Sonata for violin and piano in A major; and Fritz Kreisler’s Liebesleid and Schön Rosmarin. This performance was recorded on June 12, 2021.
programme.title: Saint-Saëns - Polonaise for two pianos, Op. 77

programme.desc: The legendary Sir András Schiff takes on the dual role of conductor and soloist in this special concert with the Freixenet Symphony Orchestra of the Reina Sofía School of Music. The program opens with Johann Sebastian Bach’s Keyboard Concerto No. 5 in F minor, BWV 1056, with Schiff himself at the piano. The concert concludes with Felix Mendelssohn’s magnificent ‘Italian’ Symphony No. 4.
programme.title: Bach Concerto & Mendelssohn Symphony No. 4

programme.desc: Japanese violinist Naoya Nishimura and Italian pianist Andrea Bacchetti perform an intimate recital recorded at the Munetsugu Hall in Nagoya, Japan. On the program are works by Arcangelo Corelli, Ludwig van Beethoven, Manuel de Falla, Maurice Ravel, Camille Saint-Saëns, Niccolò Paganini and Antonio Bazzini.
programme.title: Works for violin and piano by Corelli, Ravel a.o.

programme.desc: Since his spectacular debut recital at the Amsterdam Concertgebouw in 2002, pianist Misha Fomin has become an indispensable part of Dutch musical life. In this concert, recorded at the Concertgebouw Amsterdam, Fomin performs a number of pieces including Modest Mussorgsky’s Pictures at an Exhibition (1874).
programme.title: Misha Fomin at the Concertgebouw

programme.desc: Mahler's Symphony No. 10 is an unfinished work left by the composer at his death, representing his ultimate emotional journey from torment and heartbreak to an unreserved acceptance of life and human love.
programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 10

programme.desc: Mexican conductor Carlos Miguel Prieto leads the Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería in a performance of Gustav Mahler’s Symphony No. 1 in D major, “Titan”. Composed between 1887 and 1888, the symphony blends traditional form with innovative ideas like folk melodies, march rhythms, and fanfare motifs. This performance was recorded at Sala Nezahualcóyotl of the Centro Cultural Universitario in Mexico City, in 2012.
programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 1 in D major

programme.desc: Frank Peter Zimmermann (violin), Enrico Pace (piano).
programme.title: Bach - Sonata No. 1 BWV 1014

programme.desc: Celebrated German violinist Isabelle Faust performs two of J. S. Bach’s incredible works for solo violin: Partita No. 2 in D minor (BWV 1004), and Sonata No. 3 in C major (BWV 1005). In this wonderful performance, Faust shows her mastery of Bach’s technically challenging pieces. This performance was recorded at St. Thomas Church in Leipzig, Germany, in 2020.
programme.title: Bach - Violin Sonata No. 3 (BWV 1005)

programme.desc: Ukrainian-born pianist Inna Faliks performs Frederic Chopin's Polonaise-Fantaisie Op. 61. Recorded at the Nicols Concert Hall, Evanston, IL, USA. Faliks has established herself as one of the most communicative, and poetic artists of her generation. The Polonaise-Fantaise was dedicated to Mme A. Veyret, composed and published in 1846.
programme.title: Chopin - Polonaise-fantaisie, Op. 61

programme.desc: This film on the performance of Mahler's 9th symphony by the Gustav Mahler Jugendorchester, under the baton of Claudio Abbado, was recorded at Accademia di Santa Cecilia in Rome in 2004. The film vividly shows the joy, talent, and professionalism of the young musicians.
programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 9

programme.desc: Recorded in 2021 at Perugia's Basilica di San Pietro, Enrico Bronzi leads the Orchestra da Camera di Perugia in an intimate concert of Haydn, Mozart, and Saint-Saëns, featuring pianists Linda Di Carlo and Marco Scolastra, and mezzo-soprano Marina Comparato.
programme.title: Works by Haydn, Mozart and Saint-Saëns

programme.desc: Roberto Prosseda (1975) performs Mozart's Piano Sonata No. 5 (KV. 283) and four Impromptus Op. 90 by Franz Schubert. The performance ends with Chopin's technically demanding Ballade No. 4, Op. 52.
programme.title: Schubert - Four Impromptus, Op. 90

programme.desc: The Europakonzert 2013 was celebrated at the Prague Castle at the historical Spanish Hall. Conductor: Sir Simon Rattle. Soloist: Magdalena Kozená. Works: Williams -\n Fantasia on a Theme by Thomas Tallis, Dvořák - Ten Biblical Songs, Beethoven - Symphony No. 6.
programme.title: Europakonzert 2013 - Prague

programme.desc: Unusual Orchestral Colors and Effects. The use of less common instruments and the fresh soundscapes Mahler creates, lead to a rich and unique listening experience.
programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 7

programme.desc: The documentary “Clara Haskil - Le mystère de l’interprète” (2017) tells the remarkable life story of Romanian pianist Clara Haskil (1895-1960). Born in Bucharest into a Jewish family, she began her career as a child prodigy, entering the Bucharest Conservatory at a very young age. Haskil suffered from chronic health issues and lived through two world wars, which held back her career. Only after WWII, Haskil’s fame began to take off and she finally enjoyed international recognition.
programme.title: Clara Haskil - Le mystère de l’interprète

programme.desc: The Danish National Symphony Orchestra opens the door to a wealth of fantasy universes in this mesmerizing concert program. Under the direction of German conductor Christian Schumann, the Danish National Symphony Orchestra, Danish National Concert Choir, and Danish National Junior Choir team up to perform music from the most popular fantasy movies, TV series and video games, including The Lord of the Rings, Harry Potter, Highlander, and The Chronicles of Narnia. Featured soloists in this concert are Danish soprano Christine Nonbo Andersen, Korean percussionist Jihye Kim, Norwegian mezzo-soprano Tuva Semmingsen, Swedish bass Johan Karlström, and British actor David Bateson.
programme.title: Fantasymphony - One Concert to Rule Them All

programme.desc: Pianist Jaeden Izik-Dzurko (Canada, 1999) joins the CMIM ensemble, consisting of three principal strings players of the Montreal Symphony Orchestra, in a performance of the first movement, Sostenuto assai – Allegro ma non troppo, of Robert Schumann’s Piano Quartet in E-flat major, Op. 47. This performance took place during the chamber music round of the two-part semi-final of the Piano Edition of the Concours musical international de Montréal 2024 (CMIM). It was recorded at the Bourgie Hall of the Montreal Museum of Fine Arts.
programme.title: CMIM Piano 2024 - Semi-final I: Jaeden Izik-Dzurko

programme.desc: Italian conductor Andrea Vitello leads his Ensemble BIOS in a performance of ‘Someone Out There is Praying for Peace (Let Us Not Be the Reason), I’, by contemporary Canadian composer Rita Ueda. This piece is written for strings and tar, a traditional plucked string instrument of Persian music, played here by Saeed Mirzazadeh. Ensemble BIOS specializes in 20th and 21st century music. This performance was recorded at Chiesa di San Cristo in Brescia, Italy.
programme.title: Ueda - Someone Out There is Praying for Peace I

programme.desc: Herbert Blomstedt conducts the Gewandhaus Orchestra and Kammerchor at the Leipzig Bachfest 2005 in a performance of J. S. Bach's Mass in B minor (BWV 232). Soloists are Ruth Ziesak, Anna Larsson, Christoph Genz, and Dietrich Henschel.
programme.title: J. S. Bach: Mass in B minor, BWV 232

programme.desc: Mahler: Das Lied von der Erde, performed live by Carlos Miguel Prieto conducting the Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería, with mezzo-soprano Ruxandra Donose and tenor Ramón Vargas, presents Mahler’s song-symphony — one of the composer’s most profound masterpieces.
programme.title: Mahler – The Song of the Earth

programme.desc: This documentary portrays the Teatro Regio of Turin. Pillar of local life and symbol of excellence of the Italian operatic tradition, the Teatro Regio is a prestigious stage, hosting productions of great substance.
programme.title: Teatro Regio behind the scenes

programme.desc: Indian conductor Zubin Mehta (1936) became Music Director of the Israel Philharmonic Orchestra (IPO) in 1977 and was appointed Music Director for Life in 1981. On July 18, 1996, Mehta led the IPO in its first-ever performance of Richard Strauss’s tone poem Till Eulenspiegels lustige Streiche, Op. 28. This episode of ‘In Rehearsal’ offers an intimate look at the dialogue between Mehta and the musicians as they explore Strauss’s tone poem together.
programme.title: In Rehearsal: Zubin Mehta

programme.desc: Renowned French string quartet Quatuor Ébène marked the 250th birth anniversary of Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827) with a remarkable project: recording all of the great composer’s sixteen string quartets. For five years, violinists Pierre Colombet and Gabriel Le Magadure, violist Marie Chilemme, and cellist Raphaël Merlin immersed themselves in Beethoven’s 650 pages of sheet music. This program features Quatuor Ébène performing Beethoven’s String Quartet No. 5 in A major, Op. 18, No. 5; String Quartet No. 4 in C minor, Op. 18, No. 4; and String Quartet No. 12 in E-flat major, Op. 127. This concert was recorded at Philharmonie de Paris on December 17, 2020.
programme.title: Beethoven - String Quartets No. 4, 5 & 12

programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle conducts the London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) in Antonín Dvořák’s spirited Slavonic Dances, Op. 46 (Nos. 1-8). This performance was recorded at LSO St. Luke’s on Old Street in London, UK, on September 23, 2020.
programme.title: Dvořák – Slavonic Dances, Op. 46 (Nos. 1–8)

programme.desc: On the occasion of her 80th birthday, Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich explored chamber music repertoire in this wonderful concert, recorded at Château de Chantilly, France. The ‘Grande Dame’ of the piano is joined by various renowned artists, including pianists Lily Maisky and Iddo Bar-Shaï, violinists Tedi Papavrami and Akiko Suwanai, her daughter Lyda Chen-Argerich on viola, and cellist Mischa Maisky. On the program are Felix Mendelssohn’s Piano Trio No. 1 in D minor, Op. 49; Leoš Janáček’s Violin Sonata; Franz Schubert’s Rondo in A major, D. 951; and Johannes Brahms’s Piano Quartet No. 3 in C minor, Op. 60. These performances were recorded on May 4 and June 13, 2021.
programme.title: Janáček - Violin Sonata

programme.desc: Swiss conductor Philippe Jordan and the Orchestre de l’Opéra national de Paris recorded all of Ludwig van Beethoven’s symphonies in 2014-2015. In this program, maestro Jordan presents Beethoven’s final symphony: Symphony No. 9 in D minor, Op. 125. He conducts the Orchestre and Choeurs de l’Opéra national de Paris and four vocal soloists Ricarda Merbeth (soprano), Daniela Sindram (mezzosoprano), Robert Dean Smith (tenor), and Günther Groissböck (bass). This performance was recorded at Opéra Bastille in Paris, France, in 2015.
programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 9 in D minor, Op. 125

programme.desc: The then-newly founded Lucerne Festival Orchestra presents this stunning performance of Mahler's Resurrection Symphony in August 2003, under the baton of Claudio Abbado. The soloists Eteri Gvazava (soprano) and Anna Larsson (mezzo-soprano) are accompanied by the singers of the Orfeón Donostiarra choir.
programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 2

programme.desc: In this recording of his 2016 Deeply Mozart concert tour, Francesco Attesti (*1975) performs Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s piano concertos KV 449 and KV 488 with the Italian OIDA Orchestra and conductor Paolo Belloli.
programme.title: Mozart - Piano Concerto No. 23, KV 488

programme.desc: Swiss conductor Philippe Jordan and the Orchestre de l’Opéra national de Paris recorded all of Ludwig van Beethoven's symphonies in 2014-2015. In this program, Jordan conducts Beethoven’s Symphony No. 2 in D major, Op. 36. This performance was recorded at Palais Garnier in Paris, France, in 2014.
programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 2 in D major, Op. 36

programme.desc: Conducted by Andreas Spering, the South Netherlands Philharmonic performs Beethoven’s Sixth Symphony. Ludwig van Beethoven painted in his symphony the rustic idylls of a peasants’ picnic in the countryside, rife with murmuring brooks and a frightful thunderstorm.
programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 6

programme.desc: Mexican conductor Carlos Miguel Prieto leads the Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería in a performance of Sergei Prokofiev’s Peter and the Wolf, Op. 67. Written in 1936, Peter and the Wolf is a short, narrated orchestral suite, telling the story of a brave boy named Peter, who lives with his grandfather on the edge of a forest. With the help of his animal friends, Peter outsmarts a villainous wolf and captures it, eventually leading it to the zoo.
programme.title: Prokofiev - Peter and the Wolf

programme.desc: The documentary “The Three Lives of Clara Schumann” traces the fascinating life story of German pianist and composer Clara Schumann. Basing itself on her letters and diaries, her compositions, and on accounts from musicians who have intensively studied her music, this 2019 documentary offers a multi-angled perspective on Clara Schumann.
programme.title: The Three Lives of Clara Schumann

programme.desc: Maestro Herbert Blomstedt makes his debut with the Lucerne Festival Orchestra at 2020’s Lucerne Festival conducting Ludwig van Beethoven’s celebrated Symphony No. 3 in E-flat major, Op. 55, “Eroica”. This performance was recorded at the Lucerne Culture and Congress Center (KKL), Switzerland, in August 2020.
programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 3 in E-flat major, Op. 55

programme.desc: Conductor Teodor Currentzis leads his ensemble MusicAeterna alongside violinist Patricia Kopatchinskaja in a performance of works by Brahms and Mendelssohn, showcasing young, accomplished and energetic musicians.
programme.title: Beauty is a Crime: Mendelssohn & Brahms

programme.desc: Sergei Prokofiev based his ballet ‘Romeo and Juliet’ on William Shakespeare's famous play of the same name, telling the story of two young lovers from the feuding families Montague and Capulet. Acclaimed French choreographer Jean-Christophe Maillot created a distinctive choreography of the ballet in 1996, which has been performed to great success the world over. This 2002 interpretation is performed by the dancers of Les Ballets de Monte Carlo.
programme.title: Romeo and Juliet

programme.desc: The New European Ensemble, led by conductor Hernán Schvartzman, performs a rendition of the opera Hamlet by Ambroise Thomas. Main soloists are Quirijn de Lang and Lucie Chartin. Staged by Serge van Veggel and recorded in the Royal Theatre of The Hague, in April 2018.
programme.title: Thomas - Hamlet

programme.desc: The Imperial Ice Stars ice dance production of Cinderella is set in Siberia. The beloved story has been given a new and original twist by award winning artistic director Tony Mercer. Performed to a specially commissioned original musical score with a cast of 26 skaters, the show was shot live in August 2008 in Melbourne, Australia. Original score composed by Tim Duncan and Edward Barnwell.
programme.title: Ice Dance: Cinderella 2008

programme.desc: Pianist Vadim Repin and Violist Murad Hüseynov perform Gara Garayev's Violin Sonata and 24 Preludes for Piano. Recorded at La Grange ay Lac. Written and directed by Juliette Swierczewski and recorded at La Grange au Lac. Although Garayev is a 20th century composer, his music nonetheless carries allusions to romantic music.
programme.title: Gara Garayev : Autumn Sonatas

programme.desc: Frank Peter Zimmermann (violin), Enrico Pace (piano).
programme.title: Bach - Sonata No. 2 BWV 1015

programme.desc: At the behest of Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich, several classical music stars took part in this concert in aid of the Erasmus Fund for medical research in intensive care, recorded at the Royal Conservatory of Brussels, Belgium, on October 21, 2023. The concert pays tribute to the renowned cellist Aleksandr Khramouchin (1979) who suddenly passed away on May 13, 2023. As part of this concert, trumpetist Sergei Nakariakov and pianist Maria Meerovitch perform Lensky’s aria from Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky’s opera Eugene Onegin.
programme.title: Tchaikovsky - Lensky’s aria from Eugene Onegin

programme.desc: The film Jaroussky sings Bach & Telemann is a portrait of a very special vocalist - and of two exceptional composers: Telemann and Bach.
programme.title: Jaroussky sings Bach & Telemann

programme.desc: Marta Gardolińska conducts the London Symphony Orchestra in a concert program consisting of Lili Boulanger’s D’un Martin de Printemps, Marc-André Dalbavie’s Concerto for Flute (soloist is Gareth Davies), and Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky’s Symphony No. 4 in F minor, Op. 36. This concert was recorded at LSO St Luke’s in London, UK, on May 18, 2022.
programme.title: The LSO performs Boulanger, Dalbavie & Tchaikovsky

programme.desc: “The Unanswered Ives” (2018) is the first documentary about American modernist composer Charles Ives (1874-1954). The documentary sheds light on Ives’s life and work in all its facets, exploring his aural world by showing music performances in churches, concert halls, open-air venues, and a circus tent. Using interviews with relatives, insurance brokers, musicologists, and musicians, documentary filmmaker Anne-Kathrin Peitz explores the question “who was Charles Ives?".
programme.title: The Unanswered Ives

programme.desc: In this episode of ‘In Rehearsal,’ Latvian maestro Mariss Jansons guides the Oslo Philharmonic through the powerful Suite from Béla Bartók’s pantomime ballet The Miraculous Mandarin, culminating in a performance at the Oslo Concert Hall.
programme.title: In Rehearsal: Mariss Jansons

programme.desc: Venezuelan-born conductor Giovanni Guzzo leads the Camerata Fundación EDP of the Reina Sofía School of Music in a spirited concert. On the program are works by Christoph Willibald Gluck, J.S. Bach and W.A. Mozart. This performance was recorded at Auditorio Sony of the Reina Sofía School of Music in Madrid, Spain, on December 18, 2024.
programme.title: Works by Gluck, Bach and Mozart

programme.desc: Colombian principal conductor Andrés Orozco-Estrada took the Spanish Orquesta Sinfónica Freixenet on the road to perform at some of Europe’s greatest music centers in celebration of Madrid’s Reina Sofía School of Music’s 30th anniversary. This concert features a wonderful performance of Antonín Dvořák’s Symphony No. 8 in G major, Op. 88. It was recorded at the Liszt Ferenc Academy of Music in Budapest, Hungary on October 20, 2021.
programme.title: Dvořák - Symphony No. 8 in G major, Op. 88

programme.desc: Julijana Sarac performs the third movement of Ludwig van Beethoven’s Piano Sonata No. 21 (“Waldstein”). The work was completed in 1804 and is considered one of Beethoven's greatest and most technically challenging piano sonatas.
programme.title: Beethoven - Piano Sonata No. 21 - III

programme.desc: Renowned French string quartet Quatuor Ébène marked the 250th birth anniversary of Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827) with a remarkable project: recording all of the great composer’s sixteen string quartets. For five years, violinists Pierre Colombet and Gabriel Le Magadure, violist Marie Chilemme, and cellist Raphaël Merlin immersed themselves in Beethoven’s 650 pages of sheet music. This program features Quatuor Ébène performing Beethoven’s String Quartet No. 6 in B-flat major, Op. 18 No. 6; and String Quartet No. 15 in A minor, Op. 132. This concert performance was recorded at Philharmonie de Paris on November 24, 2020.
programme.title: Beethoven - String Quartet No. 15, Op. 132

programme.desc: In Geneva, the city where she spent the most of her life, Martha Argerich invites her lifelong music partner, the cellist Mischa Maisky, to play in private chamber music. Between each piece, Martha opens up to her daughter Annie Dutoit, in an intimate interview that brings both their intimacy and the music.
programme.title: Chopin - Introduction & Polonaise, Op. 3

programme.desc: In Geneva, the Swiss city where she has spent most of her life, Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich invites her lifelong music partner, the cellist Mischa Maisky, to play chamber music. Between the pieces, Martha opens up to her daughter Annie Dutoit in an intimate interview that addresses both their relationship and the music. This broadcast was recorded on November 12 and 13, 2020, in Geneva, Switzerland.
programme.title: Works for cello and piano by Schumann, Chopin a.o.

programme.desc: The symphony's immense emotional scope, features innovative use of large-scale forces for breathtaking sound, and an ambitious philosophical journey that connects listeners to the grandeur of the natural world.
programme.title: Symphony No. 3, in D minor

programme.desc: Franz Welser-Möst conducts the Cleveland Orchestra and Chorus in a concert performing Richard Strauss' Metamorphosen (A Study for 23 Solo Strings) and Mozart's Requiem, K. 626. Soloists are Siobhan Stagg (soprano), Avery Amereau (contralto), Ben Bliss (tenor) and Anthony Robin Schneider (bass). Recorded at Severance Hall, Cleveland in March 2023.
programme.title: Strauss' Metamorphosen & Mozart's Requiem

programme.desc: The 2018 edition of the Veerhavenconcert in Rotterdam offers an accessible program with operatic works by Verdi, Ponchielli, and Puccini. Maxim Emelyanchec leads the Dutch Philharmonic Orchestra and the Toonkunst Amsterdam choir.
programme.title: Veerhavenconcert 2018

programme.desc: Frank Peter Zimmermann (violin), Enrico Pace (piano).
programme.title: Bach - Sonata No. 4 BWV 1017

programme.desc: Swiss conductor Philippe Jordan and the Orchestre de l’Opéra national de Paris recorded all of Ludwig van Beethoven's symphonies in 2014-2015. In this program, Jordan conducts Beethoven’s Symphony No. 8 in F major, Op. 93. This performance was recorded at Opéra Bastille in Paris, France, in 2015.
programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 8 in F major, Op. 93

programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birthday, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. In this performance, Schwartz presents Schumann’s Fantasiestücke, Op. 12. Written in 1837, the work is a set of eight piano pieces with contrasting moods. The work’s title is derived from one of the composer’s favourite authors’ collection of novellas: E. T. A. Hoffmann’s Fantasiestücke in Callots Manier.
programme.title: Schumann - Fantasiestücke, Op. 12

programme.desc: Maestro Myung-Whun Chung leads the Orchestra and Chorus of the Maggio Musicale Fiorentino, along with two vocal soloists, in this impressive performance of Gustav Mahler’s Symphony No. 2 in C minor, ‘Resurrection’. Soprano Christiane Karg and alto Claudia Huckle are the soloists. Written between 1888 and 1894, this five-movement symphony is scored for a large orchestra, chorus, and soprano and alto soloists. Mahler explores themes of life, death, and resurrection throughout the symphony. This performance was recorded at Teatro del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in Florence, Italy, in 2021.
programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 2, 'Resurrection'

programme.desc: Conrad van Alphen conducts Sinfonia Rotterdam, recorded in De Doelen, Rotterdam, in 2018. Alvaro Siviero is the soloist in Grieg's Piano Concerto No. 1.
programme.title: Grieg - Piano Concerto, Op. 16

programme.desc: Johan de Meij conducts Symphony No. 1 for woodwind and brass orchestra. The work is titled “Lord of the Rings” and is based on the trilogy by J. R. R. Tolkien. This concert is recorded at the Sala dei Teatini of the Teatri di Piacenza in 2018.
programme.title: Johan de Meij - Symphony No. 1 “Lord of the Rings”

programme.desc: Mientras pasea por Italia, Sophie encuentra una carta escrita hace 50 años por Claire, una mujer que buscaba a un joven italiano llamado Lorenzo. Desde ese momento, la joven emprende un viaje por todo el país buscando al misterioso hombre.
programme.title: Cartas a Julieta
Letters to Juliet

programme.desc: Lou, una chica alegre y creativa, va de un trabajo a otro para ayudar a su familia. Un nuevo empleo pondrá a prueba su alegría: se ocupará de cuidar y acompañar a Will Traynor, un joven cínico y rico que quedó paralítico tras un accidente.
programme.title: Yo antes de ti
Me Before You

programme.desc: Después de la repentina muerte de su esposo, Libby se muda con su madre hipercrítica. De la nada, su distanciada tía Jean le ofrece a Libby y sus hijos un escape: trabajar y vivir en su granja en Texas Hill Country.
programme.title: Una nueva eternidad
The Lost Husband

programme.desc: En una aventura que les llevará más allá de todo lo que habían conocido, Poppy y Branch descubren que su tribu de Trolls es solo una de las seis que existen.

Trolls World Tour

programme.desc: Lyra Belacqua es una niña de doce años que hará un largo viaje para intentar salvar a su amigo Roger. En el camino se encontrará con todo tipo de extrañas criaturas, brujas y otros animales de un universo paralelo.
programme.title: La brújula dorada
The Golden Compass

programme.desc: Frustrado creativamente y abocado a la ruina, Cage, interpretándose a sí mismo, debe aceptar una oferta de un millón de dólares por asistir al cumpleaños de un peligroso admirador.

The Unbearable Weight of Massive Talent

programme.desc: La pareja más letal del mundo, el guardaespaldas Michael Bryce y el sicario Darius Kincaid, lucha contra una villana que pretende destruir Europa. Pero no lo harán solos, la impredecible esposa de Darius los acompaña en la misión.
programme.title: Duro de cuidar 2
The Hitman's Wife's Bodyguard

programme.desc: Daniel y Adrian entrenan muy duro en el gimnasio cada día. Deciden pasar a la acción y dar un gran golpe. Los dos, junto a Paul, un ex presidiario temeroso de Dios, forman un grupo para extorsionar y secuestrar a un empresario adinerado.

programme.title: Hollywood on Set

programme.desc: Annie enfrenta su primer desafío en la panadería familiar cuando la receta de su abuela desaparece y, con la ayuda de Sam, el panadero local, se embarca en una misión para recuperarla.

A Christmas Cookie Catastrophe

programme.desc: En 1903, Charles pelea con su prometida y viaja en el tiempo hasta 2020. Ahora, junto a Megan, la curadora del museo, busca regresar a casa mientras descubre secretos y un nuevo amor.
programme.title: Una Navidad atemporal
A Timeless Christmas

programme.desc: Roger se inscribe con el Dr. P, quien usa métodos extraños pero efectivos, en un curso para mejorar su autoestima. Muy pronto, alumno y profesor entran en conflicto cuando se enamoran de la misma joven.
programme.title: Escuela de tontos
School for Scoundrels

programme.desc: Landon y Jamie son dos chicos completamente diferentes entre sí. Sin embargo, el contacto cotidiano los hace enamorarse y madurar, pero la felicidad de ambos se verá empañada por un secreto que la joven oculta.
programme.title: Un amor para recordar
A Walk to Remember

programme.desc: Poco convencido de aceptar su destino como futuro rey, Edward huye de sus responsabilidades hacia el Medio-Oeste Americano. Allí, cambia su nombre por el de Eddie, se matricula en la universidad y se enamora de Paige.

The Prince and Me

programme.desc: Una madre soltera, que ha criado con esfuerzo a tres hijas, trata de evitar que una de ellas repita sus errores, por lo que se lanza a la búsqueda del marido perfecto, cometiendo todo tipo de deslices.
programme.title: ¡Porque yo lo digo!
Because I Said So

programme.desc: Las joyas de la Corona desaparecieron, y Johnny English debe investigar el caso, un agente tan entregado al trabajo como inexperto.
programme.title: Johnny English

programme.desc: Cuando un ciberataque revela la identidad de los agentes secretos en actividad del Reino Unido, Johnny English se convierte en la única esperanza. Pero para dar con el hacker, Johnny deberá esforzarse y adaptarse a la tecnología moderna.
programme.title: Johnny English 3.0
Johnny English Strikes Again

programme.desc: Después de cinco años de matrimonio, la relación de John y Jane está por terminar, hasta que sale a la luz la profesión de cada uno. Ambos resultan ser asesinos a sueldo de organizaciones rivales que han puesto precio a sus cabezas.
programme.title: Sr. y Sra. Smith
Mr. and Mrs. Smith

programme.desc: Una estricta policía hace lo imposible para proteger a la viuda de un traficante de drogas de delincuentes y policías corruptos. Juntas se embarcarán en una aventura por Texas que las hará enfrentarse con pistoleros asesinos y farsantes.

programme.desc: Talia y su mejor amigo de la infancia, Anderson, se reúnen inesperadamente en un pueblo familiar lleno de espíritu navideño que restaura a sus visitantes durante tiempos de profunda agitación.
programme.title: Un inesperado cuento de Navidad
A Fabled Holiday

programme.desc: Jennifer y Meg son hermanas muy unidas que viven distanciadas. La primera está en Salt Lake City, dirige un exitoso restaurante que abrió con su difunto esposo; la segunda se quedó en Hazelwood, en la panadería local de sus padres.
programme.title: Intercambio de hermanas: Navidad en el pueblo
Sister Swap: A Hometown Holiday

programme.desc: Mary Fiore es una experta en bodas. La mejor. Sabe exactamente cómo planificar la ceremonia, aconsejar a las novias, decorar los salones, poner cada detalle a punto; pero sabe muy poco acerca del amor.
programme.title: Experta en bodas
The Wedding Planner

programme.desc: Una rubia intelectualmente desafiante ingresa en la Escuela de Leyes de Harvard con el único objetivo de recuperar a su novio. Deberá librar la batalla de su vida, por su novio, por ella misma y por todas aquellas que sufren por ser rubias.
programme.title: Legalmente rubia
Legally Blonde

programme.desc: Para Holly la muerte de su marido ensombrece su futuro. Pero la aparición de varios mensajes en los que su esposo le explica cómo seguir adelante, serán el punto de partida para rehacer su vida.

PS I Love You

Bridget Jones's Diary

programme.title: El bebé de Bridget Jones
Bridget Jones's Baby

programme.desc: Para sacarlo de su reciente racha de derrotas, una tenista convertida en entrenadora apunta a su marido, un campeón del Grand Slam de fama, a un torneo challenger contra su antiguo mejor amigo, que además también es el exnovio de ella.
programme.title: Desafiantes
Challengers

programme.desc: El devoto guardavidas Mitch Buchannon deberá aliarse con un bravucón socorrista novato para desenmascarar una trama delictiva que amenaza el futuro de la bahía.
programme.title: Baywatch: guardianes de la bahía
Baywatch

programme.desc: Freddy Krueger ha sido olvidado. Desesperado, resucita a Jason Voorhees para que siembre el miedo entre los adolescentes de la calle Elm. Pero Jason tendrá sus propios planes, por lo que ambos protagonizarán un enfrentamiento.
programme.title: Freddy contra Jason
Freddy vs. Jason

programme.desc: Chucky y su esposa Tiffany han sido resucitados por su hijo. La diabólica pareja se embarca en una nueva serie de asesinatos, sin imaginar que el joven no está dispuesto a seguir sus pasos.
programme.title: El hijo de Chucky
Seed of Chucky

programme.desc: Nica está internada en el manicomio, convencida de que fue ella la que mató a su familia. En su tratamiento, su psiquiatra utiliza un muñeco, cuya aparición coincide con una horrible cadena de crímenes: Chucky ha regresado.
programme.title: Culto a Chucky
Cult of Chucky

programme.desc: S14 E28 — Mujer Maravilla / Las aventuras del Capitán Calzoncillos: La película / Piratas del Caribe: La.. Vemos el detrás de escena de "Mujer Maravilla." Luego, nos inmiscuimos en la película "Las aventuras del Capitán Calzoncillos: La película." Además, visitamos el set de "Piratas del Caribe: La venganza de Salazar.".
programme.title: Hollywood on Set

programme.desc: S1 E1 — La gran muralla / LEGO Batman: la película / ¡Huye! Te mostramos el backstage de las peliculas: La gran muralla, LEGO Batman: la película y ¡Huye! Conoce todos los detalles del detrás de escena, de estos set's de Hollywood.
programme.title: Hollywood on Set

programme.desc: S1 E14 — El regreso de Mary Poppins / La voz de la igualdad / Si la colonia hablara Te mostramos el detrás de escena de las películas: El regreso de Mary Poppins, la voz de la igualdad y Si la colonia hablara.
programme.title: Hollywood on Set

programme.desc: Dos hermanas encuentran un nuevo propósito y descubren lo que realmente necesitan en la vida durante la fiesta navideña.
programme.title: Intercambio de hermanas: Navidad en la ciudad
Sister Swap: Christmas in the City

programme.desc: Después de la repentina muerte de su esposo, Libby se muda con su madre hipercrítica. De la nada, su distanciada tía Jean le ofrece a Libby y sus hijos un escape: trabajar y vivir en su granja en Texas Hill Country.
programme.title: Una nueva eternidad
The Lost Husband

programme.desc: Lou, una chica alegre y creativa, va de un trabajo a otro para ayudar a su familia. Un nuevo empleo pondrá a prueba su alegría: se ocupará de cuidar y acompañar a Will Traynor, un joven cínico y rico que quedó paralítico tras un accidente.
programme.title: Yo antes de ti
Me Before You

programme.desc: Mientras pasea por Italia, Sophie encuentra una carta escrita hace 50 años por Claire, una mujer que buscaba a un joven italiano llamado Lorenzo. Desde ese momento, la joven emprende un viaje por todo el país buscando al misterioso hombre.
programme.title: Cartas a Julieta
Letters to Juliet

programme.desc: Un joven rebelde abandona sus estudios y se alista en el ejército, sin saber qué hacer con su vida, hasta que conoce a la chica de sus sueños, Savannah, con la que mantendrá una irregular relación marcada por los acontecimientos.
programme.title: Querido John
Dear John

programme.desc: Landon y Jamie son dos chicos completamente diferentes entre sí. Sin embargo, el contacto cotidiano los hace enamorarse y madurar, pero la felicidad de ambos se verá empañada por un secreto que la joven oculta.
programme.title: Un amor para recordar
A Walk to Remember

programme.desc: Una madre soltera, que ha criado con esfuerzo a tres hijas, trata de evitar que una de ellas repita sus errores, por lo que se lanza a la búsqueda del marido perfecto, cometiendo todo tipo de deslices.
programme.title: ¡Porque yo lo digo!
Because I Said So

programme.desc: Cuando Gwen, la prometida de su hermano, lo encuentra y le ruega que la ayude a buscar a su desaparecido amor, Lawrence regresa a casa y se entera de que algo brutal, salvaje, con una sed insaciable de sangre ha matado a muchos campesinos.
programme.title: El hombre lobo
The Wolfman

programme.desc: Una joven agente del FBI intenta, analizando la mente de un psicópata encarcelado, obtener elementos que le permitan localizar a otro asesino serial.
programme.title: El silencio de los inocentes
The Silence of the Lambs

programme.desc: Cuenta la historia de un novelista de terror que sólo cree en aquello que ven sus ojos, desacreditando todos los fenómenos paranormales. Sin embargo, sus creencias cambiarán cuando entre en la habitación 1408 del Hotel Dolphin.

Un guardia de seguridad de un centro comercial se ve envuelto en un misterio alrededor de unos escaparates con espejos en el departamento de ropa que aparentemente hacen que saque lo peor de las personas que se reflejan en ellos.
programme.title: Espejos siniestros
Mirrors

programme.desc: El detective Shawn Spencer y su mejor amigo intentan resolver en secreto un caso sobrenatural.
programme.title: Psíquico 2: Lassie regresa
Psych 2: Lassie Come Home

programme.desc: S1 E20 — La familia que tú eliges / Downton Abbey / Carnival Row Nos sumergimos en la creme de Hollywood, para conocer el set de filmación y su detrás de cámara, de las películas: La familia que tú eliges, Downton Abbey y Carnival Row.
programme.title: Hollywood on Set

programme.desc: S1 E21 — Frozen 2 / Aguas oscuras / Queen y Slim: los fugitivos Nos inmiscuimos en el set y el backstage de las películas: Frozen 2, Aguas oscuras y Queen y Slim: los fugitivos.
programme.title: Hollywood on Set

programme.desc: S1 E22 — Star Wars: El ascenso de Skywalker / Mujercitas / Negra Navidad Nos inmiscuimos en el set de filmación de las películas: Star Wars: El ascenso de Skywalker, Mujercitas y Negra Navidad.
programme.title: Hollywood on Set

programme.desc: Hank, un perro encantador, tiene la cabeza llena de sueños sobre convertirse en samurái, pero debe superar una serie de pruebas para derrotar a sus enemigos.
programme.title: El perro samurai: La leyenda de Kakamucho
Blazing Samurai

programme.desc: Cinco famosos delincuentes tratan de realizar su empresa más complicada hasta la fecha: portarse bien.
programme.title: Los tipos malos
The Bad Guys

programme.desc: Cuando el maníaco Dr. Robotnik regresa a la Tierra con un nuevo aliado Knucles, Sonic forma equipo con su propio compañero de fatigas, Tails, y juntos intentarán detenerlo.
programme.title: Sonic 2: La película
Sonic the Hedgehog 2

programme.desc: Mientras trabajan bajo tierra para reparar una tubería, los plomeros de Brooklyn Mario y su hermano Luigi son transportados a un mundo mágico. Allí, emprenderán un viaje épico para rescatar a la princesa Peach.
programme.title: Super Mario Bros. La película
The Super Mario Bros. Movie

programme.desc: El adolescente Miles Morales se convierte en el Hombre Araña de su realidad, cruzándose en su camino con cinco contrapartes de otras dimensiones para detener una amenaza de todas las realidades.
programme.title: Spider-Man: Un nuevo universo
Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse

programme.desc: Coraline es una niña que se muda con sus padres a una casa enorme. Aburrida, empieza a explorar las innumerables puertas del lugar y acaba abriendo una que la lleva a otra casa y a otro mundo donde quieren mantenerla presa.
programme.title: Coraline y la puerta secreta
Coraline

programme.desc: Víctor está a punto de casarse con Victoria. Una noche, en el bosque, el joven termina por accidente comprometido con el cadáver de una novia. Mientras él intenta regresar al lado de su amor, ella lo espera en el mundo de los vivos.
programme.title: El cadáver de la novia
Tim Burton's Corpse Bride

programme.desc: Un huérfano se va vivir con su abuela, pero ambos tendrán apariciones de brujas. Deciden irse a vivir a un hotel de lujo con la desgracia que llegan exactamente al mismo tiempo que la Gran Bruja.
programme.title: Las brujas
The Witches

programme.desc: A pesar de estar enterrada en una tumba en lo más profundo del desierto, una antigua princesa, cuyo destino le fue arrebatado injustamente, se despierta en la época actual, trayendo consigo una maldición.
programme.title: La momia
The Mummy

programme.desc: Un sacerdote con un pasado encantado y una novicia en el umbral de sus votos son enviados por el Vaticano para investigar la muerte de una joven monja en Rumania, y deberán enfrentarse a una fuerza malévola en forma de una monja demoníaca.
programme.title: La monja
The Nun

programme.desc: Cinco personas quedan atrapadas en un ascensor, y se dan cuenta que no es un accidente. Luego de varios incidentes violentos y ataques inexplicables que los mata uno por uno, el diablo les hace saber que esa pesadilla es real.
programme.title: La reunión del Diablo
Devil

programme.desc: En 1989, el 911 recibió una llamada de María Rossi confesando un brutal asesinato cometido por ella. Veinte años después, su hija Isabella busca descubrir si su madre está mentalmente insana o si, en realidad, está poseída por un demonio.
programme.title: Con el Diablo adentro
The Devil Inside

programme.desc: En 1903, Charles pelea con su prometida y viaja en el tiempo hasta 2020. Ahora, junto a Megan, la curadora del museo, busca regresar a casa mientras descubre secretos y un nuevo amor.
programme.title: Una Navidad atemporal
A Timeless Christmas

programme.desc: S14 E28 — Mujer Maravilla / Las aventuras del Capitán Calzoncillos: La película / Piratas del Caribe: La.. Vemos el detrás de escena de "Mujer Maravilla." Luego, nos inmiscuimos en la película "Las aventuras del Capitán Calzoncillos: La película." Además, visitamos el set de "Piratas del Caribe: La venganza de Salazar.".
programme.title: Hollywood on Set

programme.desc: En el mundo futurista de Metro City, el científico Dr. Tenma crea a Astro Boy para reemplazar al hijo que acaba de perder, programando su creación con extraordinarios súper poderes.
programme.title: Astro Boy

programme.desc: Captain no es el pirata más peligroso ni el más inteligente, pero tiene una misión: ganar el galardón al mejor del año. Para lograrlo, no solo deberá enfrentar a sus rivales en un viaje lleno de aventuras, sino a la propia Reina.
programme.title: Piratas: una loca aventura
The Pirates! Band of Misfits

programme.desc: Felicia es una niña que vive en un orfanato en su Bretaña natal. Su pasión es la danza y sueña con convertirse en una bailarina profesional. Para conseguirlo se escapa con la ayuda de su amigo Víctor y viaja hasta el París de 1879.
programme.title: Bailarina
Ballerina

programme.desc: Un joven llamado Kubo debe localizar un traje de armadura mágico usado por su difunto padre con el fin de derrotar a un espíritu vengativo del pasado.
programme.title: Kubo y la búsqueda samurái
Kubo and the Two Strings

programme.desc: Drácula es el anfitrión del Hotel Transylvania, un complejo de alta calidad donde los monstruos pueden vivir tranquilamente, sin molestar a los seres humanos. Pero su universo corre peligro cuando un chico ordinario tropieza con el lugar.
programme.title: Hotel Transylvania

programme.desc: Los Trolls son las criaturas más felices y alegres que irrumpen en la música. Pero su entorno cambiará para siempre cuando su líder Poppy debe embarcarse en una misión que la llevará muy lejos del único mundo que ha conocido.
programme.title: Trolls

programme.desc: En una aventura que les llevará más allá de todo lo que habían conocido, Poppy y Branch descubren que su tribu de Trolls es solo una de las seis que existen.
programme.title: Trolls 2: Gira mundial
Trolls World Tour

programme.desc: S5 E9 Patrick Jane (Simon Baker), un consultor independiente del Departamento de Investigaciones de California, con un notable historial de resolución de crímenes graves utilizando solo sus habilidades de observación. Conocido por su flagrante falta de protocolo y su casi celebridad pasada como médium psíquico – cuyas habilidades paranormales ahora admite que fingió – el papel de Jane en descifrar una serie los casos difíciles de alto perfil son muy valorados por sus compañeros agentes. Sin embargo, la sensata agente Teresa Lisbon (Robin Tunney) se resiste abiertamente a tener a Jane en su unidad y alterna entre reconocer de mala gana la utilidad de Jane y criticarlo por sus actos de teatro, narcisismo y peligrosa falta de límites. El equipo de Lisbon incluye a los agentes Kimball Cho (Tim Kang), Wayne Rigsby (Owain Yeoman) y la novata Grace Van Pelt (Amanda Righetti), quienes creen que Jane es un cañón suelto, pero que admiran su encanto y habilidad para solucionar los casos.
programme.title: The Mentalist

programme.desc: S5 E15 Patrick Jane (Simon Baker), un consultor independiente del Departamento de Investigaciones de California, con un notable historial de resolución de crímenes graves utilizando solo sus habilidades de observación. Conocido por su flagrante falta de protocolo y su casi celebridad pasada como médium psíquico – cuyas habilidades paranormales ahora admite que fingió – el papel de Jane en descifrar una serie los casos difíciles de alto perfil son muy valorados por sus compañeros agentes. Sin embargo, la sensata agente Teresa Lisbon (Robin Tunney) se resiste abiertamente a tener a Jane en su unidad y alterna entre reconocer de mala gana la utilidad de Jane y criticarlo por sus actos de teatro, narcisismo y peligrosa falta de límites. El equipo de Lisbon incluye a los agentes Kimball Cho (Tim Kang), Wayne Rigsby (Owain Yeoman) y la novata Grace Van Pelt (Amanda Righetti), quienes creen que Jane es un cañón suelto, pero que admiran su encanto y habilidad para solucionar los casos.
programme.title: The Mentalist

programme.desc: S7 E1 Patrick Jane (Simon Baker), un consultor independiente del Departamento de Investigaciones de California, con un notable historial de resolución de crímenes graves utilizando solo sus habilidades de observación. Conocido por su flagrante falta de protocolo y su casi celebridad pasada como médium psíquico – cuyas habilidades paranormales ahora admite que fingió – el papel de Jane en descifrar una serie los casos difíciles de alto perfil son muy valorados por sus compañeros agentes. Sin embargo, la sensata agente Teresa Lisbon (Robin Tunney) se resiste abiertamente a tener a Jane en su unidad y alterna entre reconocer de mala gana la utilidad de Jane y criticarlo por sus actos de teatro, narcisismo y peligrosa falta de límites. El equipo de Lisbon incluye a los agentes Kimball Cho (Tim Kang), Wayne Rigsby (Owain Yeoman) y la novata Grace Van Pelt (Amanda Righetti), quienes creen que Jane es un cañón suelto, pero que admiran su encanto y habilidad para solucionar los casos.
programme.title: The Mentalist

programme.title: The Son

programme.desc: S2 E1 — Numunuu En 1852, el joven Eli comanda un ataque comanche en México. En 1915, la familia McCullough enfrenta una amenaza en su creciente negocio petrolero.
programme.title: The Son

programme.desc: S2 E2 — 10 dólares y un ganso desplumado En 1852, luego de un ataque devastador, el joven Eli debe ayudar a los comanches a reagruparse. En 1915, el regreso de Pete a la familia causa división en los McCullough.
programme.title: The Son

programme.desc: S2 E3 — El tigre ciego En 1852, los comanches del joven Eli deben sobrevivir un viaje peligroso. En 1915, Eli y Pete se ven obligados a trabajar juntos para lidiar con un enemigo nuevo.
programme.title: The Son

programme.desc: S1 E1 — Adel, Georgia La ciudad de Adel, Georgia, se ve sacudida por un brutal homicidio durante un robo; un forastero es señalado como el asesino. Ahora, 20 años después, nuevas pruebas plantean la cuestión de si un inocente está pagando por el crimen de otro.
programme.title: Crímenes reales: ¿Sucedió aquí?
True Crime Story: It Couldn't Happen Here

programme.desc: S1 E2 — Sauquoit, Nueva York Cuando una querida quiropráctica de Sauquoit, Nueva York, muere repentinamente en extrañas circunstancias, los investigadores descubren que fue asesinada con un veneno poco común.
programme.title: Crímenes reales: ¿Sucedió aquí?
True Crime Story: It Couldn't Happen Here

programme.desc: S1 E3 — San Agustín, Florida Una joven mujer en San Agustín, Florida, con toda la vida por delante, es encontrada muerta con la pistola que pertenece a su novio, un ayudante del comisario. Él dice que fue un suicidio, pero su familia cree que fue un asesinato.
programme.title: Crímenes reales: ¿Sucedió aquí?
True Crime Story: It Couldn't Happen Here

programme.desc: S1 E4 — Cookeville, Tennessee Cuando una pareja de inmigrantes en Cookeville, Tennessee, es ejecutada mientras duerme y su casa es incendiada, los investigadores identifican a un sospechoso que tiene un motivo.
programme.title: Crímenes reales: ¿Sucedió aquí?
True Crime Story: It Couldn't Happen Here
